commands.name: Write System Parameters to FLASH-EPROM
commands.exclude_reason: Writes flash: SFV, SGD, SED, SRX/Y/Z, SOX/Y/Z, SFX/Y/Z, SAX/Y, SSM, SYB, SYS, SST, SLA, SHS, SXT and the PTG 99..101 calibration values.

commands.name: Read System Parameters to FLASH-EPROM
commands.exclude_reason: Reloads the stored setup from flash and overwrites the running parameters. Service action.

commands.name: Erase all Setup Data in the Flash
commands.exclude_reason: Erases all flash data. Spec: service only, can damage the instrument.
